notes.title: Join our Discord community
notes.notes: [p]Let's be honest - every app has bugs, and ours is no exception.[/p][p]But here's the thing: we actually want to fix them. And we want your help.[/p][p]Our new Discord server is live, and it's the best place to: [/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Report issues[/b] - Found a bug? Tell us[/p][/*][*][p][b]Suggest improvements[/b] - Got ideas? We're listening [/p][/*][*][p][b]Share content[/b] - Memes, clips, whatever you've got [/p][/*][*][p][b]Connect with users[/b] - Find people who get your humor [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Come for the memes, stay for the community. [/p][p]See you on the other side![/p][p][/p][h3][b][url="https://discord.com/invite/83uhygaD87"]https://discord.com/invite/83uhygaD87[/url][/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p]
